newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures downtick after 2-yr sale.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures downtick after 2-yr sale.

text.p: Feb 25 - U.S. debt futures downticked to day's lows after the two-year T-note auction produced 5.885 pct high yield, 2.21 bid cover and $1.321 billion non-comp bids. Brokers called auction sloppy with non-comp bids somewhat disappointing, but overall not as poor as some expected. Some said fall in March T-bond below 112-19/32 could bring drop to 112-03/32.
